exact_promoted_claim: finite witness acceptance count for machine-checked v12 theorem inventory rows; never public-promotion, empirical, or prediction support in v12 unless a future prospective protocol explicitly flips release_promotion_allowed, prediction_support_allowed, and empirical_support_allowed after review
held_out_policy: finite replay split generated from theorem registry; negative controls paired per theorem
replay_rule: replay accepted cases from theorem inventory rows when finite runner failure_total=0
negative_controls: remove a required tuple component and observe rejected stronger reading
falsifier_condition: any finite model case has observed verdict different from expected
quarantine_reason: finite proof-corpus consistency check; not empirical support
